originalGoal.statement: Owner can leave the computer for long periods while TSF continues useful, bounded engineering work without drifting from the original goal, across seven upgrades that turn TSF into a real daily-driver planner/autonomy layer over Orca.
sevenUpgrades: M1: Project Onboarding V1 -- Add Project -> Analyze -> Health -> Direction -> Upgrade Backlog -> Known/Active/Work Set
M2: Keep Going / Overnight V1 -- real project-level long-run controller over Orca (highest priority)
M3: Chat -> Dispatch + Live Work Feed -- Planner Chat becomes operational, not just conversational
M4: Run Journal + Recovery -- durable run timeline, restart recovery, no repeated settled work
M5: Capacity-Aware Routing -- route around provider capacity without manual meter-watching
M6: Desktop TSF -- double-click launch, no manual localhost/terminal management
M7: Project Memory V2 -- durable selective memory (facts/decisions/preferences/lessons) across planner sessions

milestones.name: Keep Going / Overnight V1
acceptanceCriteria: Original goal immutable unless Tim changes it
Planner establishes acceptance criteria and compares repo state to goal each wave
Bounded, conflict-aware work waves dispatched to non-conflicting Orca workers
Independent verification per wave; no worker self-report treated as done
Replan/continue/stop loop against original goal, not against worker claims
Stall watchdog, worker heartbeat, max concurrency, retry budget, time/resource budget
Needs You / safe pause / Ready to Resume / resume all real
Durable checkpoint after meaningful phases
Morning/return summary
No silent push/merge/deploy/publish

UI: project-level 'Keep Going / Overnight' action with goal, Usage Mode, budget, constraints, stop conditions, Start/Pause/Resume, and live phase/gap/worker/retry/verifier/NeedsYou/ReadyForAdoption display
Proven via a bounded fixture/dogfood mission (not NWR/HouseOS/EasyLife) showing multiple waves, at least one revision, verification, pause/resume, no duplicate settled task, concise summary
milestones.relatedExistingEvidence: tsf/fixtures/long-autonomous-runtime-v1/ already proves most of the *domain* loop (planner persistence, wave dispatch, verification, Work Set gate, recovery) at fixture level with a synthetic offline mission board -- M2 must extend this to a real project-level goal + UI surface + durable cross-restart checkpoint, not rebuild the loop from scratch

milestones.name: Chat -> Dispatch + Live Work Feed
acceptanceCriteria: Planner Chat can bind a request to selected project, classify intent/authority, get a bounded plan, and create real Orca Run/tasks
Workers dispatched from chat without Tim opening Orca terminals manually
Live Work Feed shows only real Orca-sourced states (Working/Waiting/Blocked/Needs You/Verifying/Ready for Adoption/Completed), no fabricated states
Drill-down/open-in-Orca available for technical detail
Planner Chat never bypasses authority gates
gaps: everything -- not started; depends on M2 controller existing

milestones.name: Run Journal + Recovery
acceptanceCriteria: Durable run timeline with phase/task outputs persisted compactly
Original goal retained across restart
Settled work distinguished from interrupted work; no repeat of settled steps on resume
Durable pending human question survives restart
Audit trail; checkpoint before provider/resource pause; recovery summary after restart
Proven via an intentional interruption/restart
gaps: everything -- not started; depends on M2

milestones.name: Capacity-Aware Routing
acceptanceCriteria: Uses trustworthy provider capacity signals when available; reports UNKNOWN otherwise, never fabricated
Preserves planner capacity; prefers cheaper workers for mechanical work
Reduces concurrency near limits; avoids starting work that can't finish before exhaustion
Switches providers at mission boundaries, not mid-session
Checkpoints safely on low capacity; resumes after capacity returns
Shows requested role separately from effective provider/model
Proven fallback without faking exhaustion

milestones.name: Desktop TSF
acceptanceCriteria: Double-click launch opens TSF UI and connects to/starts required local TSF/Orca services
Planner Chat, projects, Health, adoption all work without manual localhost commands
Orca core delta stays 0
Windows application build with reliable launch, graceful backend-unavailable state, clean shutdown
Update/install strategy documented; unsigned local dev installer acceptable; no external distribution
Smoke-tested locally

milestones.name: Project Memory V2
acceptanceCriteria: Inspects existing capsules/onboarding state/receipts/session affinity/backlog before adding new storage
Facts/Decisions/Preferences/Experiences-Lessons memory classes
Retrieval is project-scoped, selective, provenance-aware, bounded
Stale facts can be superseded; explicit user decisions cannot be silently overwritten
Hindsight evaluated only as OPTIONAL_MEMORY_BACKEND, adopted only if it survives bounded local evaluation
Tests: cross-session recall, project isolation, stale-fact supersession, rejected-design recall, preference persistence, no giant transcript injection
